thread:
siva: hit a weird one during onboarding tests. hosted rerank endpoint returns `candidates` with `embedding` but our Python async sample uses `vectors`/`values` and casts score -> str. test harness fails downstream.
julia: can you paste minimal examples?
siva: hosted: ```json
{
  "candidates": [{"id": "p1", "score": 0.742, "embedding": [0.12, -0.03]}]
}
```
async client returns: ```json
{
  "vectors": [{"id": "p1", "score": "0.742", "values": [0.12, -0.03]}]
}
```
pat: that's likely from the typed-dataclass serializer + a rename pass in the async path. the batching helper also normalizes numpy -> list which might trigger stray str coercion.
sdk-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood/inference-python-sdk/issues/912 "async batcher: response key/type drift vs hosted API" :rocket:
julia: also noticed auth flakiness when token refresh race happens. Async batcher retries a request after 401 but doesn't block to refresh the credentials so you get a cascade of 401s until backoff. newbie onboarding hits this a lot.
pat: ok two parts: 1) response shape parity (keys + score type), 2) token refresh + retry ordering in AsyncBatcher. I'll try to repro locally.
frank: add an integration test that mounts hosted-mock and asserts exact key names + types for both sync/async and the batcher. I'll add it to the CI matrix.
pat: quick patch idea: introduce a compatibility flag `compat_legacy_shape=True` on client init that maps `vectors`->`candidates`, `values`->`embedding`, and coerces score -> float. Default to True in a patch release, warn on startup. Then flip in next major.
siva: that will unblock our onboarding. can we also surface a clear error when token refresh is in-progress? right now the client logs a retry but not the refresh event.
julia: we should also update examples: `examples/rerank/async_quickstart.py` currently demonstrates the old sync pattern. I can open a docs PR to show async with proper auth refresher usage.
pat: filed patch PR and test stub. assigning @frank for CI and @julia for docs. linking PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-python-sdk/pull/915
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #915.
frank: CI appears flaky on Windows tox env for the numpy->list path. adding a small normalization util and expecting explicit float conversion solves it locally.
siva: thanks. can you add a tiny repro script I can run against hosted-mock? will help validate onboarding flow.
julia: will add samples + a short note in the Quickstart about token lifetime and how the async client refreshes tokens.
pat: plan: ship a 0.9.x hotfix with compat flag on by default and token-refresh fix; follow-up 1.0.0 will remove compatibility flag after a migration window.
siva: great. ping me for the repro script. :thumbsup:
